79271.subject: 🟪 NEWS: Blockworks introduces Agentic Detection
79271.body:
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/38f19638-14d6-4f17-8f68-5ae4d2eedf64/Agentic-Detection-202609d_Website_Article-Image-02.jpg?t=1789614735)
Caption: 



Customers of [Blockworks Monitoring](https://blockworks.com/products/monitoring) can now receive real-time alerts the moment our agents identify them, without waiting for an analyst to review. Customers get immediate visibility into a wider range of activity across the assets they follow.

When an exchange lists an asset, it takes on a responsibility that extends far beyond launch day. A security incident can demand an immediate response. A token migration can require coordination across the business. Keeping up with that activity across hundreds of assets takes constant attention, and even a team with endless resources will miss key updates.

Agentic Detection closes that gap. Within seconds of an event, it tells you what happened, which assets or organizations are involved, and where the information came from. Before an alert reaches your team, Monitoring filters the source material, connects related reporting, and organizes the findings with the original sources attached, so you can examine the evidence yourself.

Until now, every alert needed analyst approval before it reached customers. Analysts had to prioritize what they reviewed, and updates took minutes instead of seconds. Agentic Detection makes our findings available immediately.

Our mission at Blockworks is to build trust in onchain markets. For the exchanges, brokerages, and institutions supporting these markets, that trust depends on work that continues long after an asset is listed. Agentic Detection gives teams a wider view of those assets and more time to respond as they change.

To see how Monitoring can support your team, [contact Blockworks for a demo](https://blockworks.com/contact).

_P.S. To learn more, read our _[_launch announcement._](https://blockworks.com/insights/introducing-agentic-detection-asset-monitoring-built-for-the-ai-era)

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/e60d7cde-4250-41f8-9443-28ed51b80560/divider_transparent.png?t=1774649182)

Today’s newsletter is brought to you by **[Choose Rich Live](https://www.youtube.com/@chooserichnick/streams)**[!](https://www.youtube.com/@chooserichnick/streams)

Our very own Nick O’Neill is has launched a new stream covering crypto, finance, AI, tech, and the stories shaping the internet economy.

If you already follow Nick, you know what to expect: sharp takes, market chaos, founder brain, and the occasional banger you’ll see clipped on the timeline five minutes later.

Episodes will be streaming live on YouTube, so make sure you’re subscribed to catch the next one as it happens.

**[Subscribe to Choose Rich Live!](https://www.youtube.com/@chooserichnick/streams)**

———————————————————————————

## Top Stories

**BTC** $76,921 (1.4%) | **ETH** $2,467 (2.6%) | **SOL** $101 (3.8%)

* Fed raises interest rates 25bps in [unanimous vote](https://x.com/DeItaone/status/2100285053679100323?s=20) — Goldman Sachs now expects another [25bps Fed hike](https://x.com/DeItaone/status/2100521060953137344) in October

* US spot bitcoin ETFs post a [$450.4M outflow](https://x.com/CoinbaseMarkets/status/2100378449906917507), largest since June 25

* U.S. diesel hits a[ record $6.40/gallon](https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2100529528078577672), up more than 88% in 9 months

* House Financial Services votes 28–21 to advance the [Strategic Bitcoin Reserve bill,](https://x.com/CoinDesk/status/2100525776068059296) the first such bill to clear a full House committee

* OpenAI publishes a misalignment disclosure [framework](https://x.com/OpenAI/status/2100344867507327087) — [ChatGPT ads](https://x.com/gdb/status/2100369354319884703) go live with Shopify as first commerce partner

* Nikita Bier flags XMoney [token-association](https://x.com/nikitabier/status/2100421095551565882) hacks as opt-out-worthy reply spam

* Coinbase One lifts USDC rewards to [3.75% APY](https://x.com/coinbase/status/2100339114780291439)

* Arc mainnet launch faces a number of issues including team [shilling competing memecoins](https://x.com/StarPlatinum_/status/2100353400693194766?s=20)
